pattern: a session whose file tools can't leave its folder hands even a one-sentence edit there to a child
experience: Antigravity's file tools refuse any path outside its working folder. Told to delegate, it started a child for a one-sentence edit, which took about 3 minutes and 3x the tokens of doing the edit itself.
rule: Astrolabe project docs: if your folder list says your file tools can't reach a folder, delegate_task the job with repository set to that folder's key: the child works there.

astrolabe_project_query.syntax:
Base keys: filters, formulas, properties, summaries, views.
View keys: type (table, cards, list, kanban, map), name, filters, order (the columns, a list of property ids), sort (a list of property and direction ASC or DESC), groupBy, limit, summaries (property id: summary name).
Summaries: Average, Min, Max, Sum, Range, Median, Stddev, Earliest, Latest, Checked, Unchecked, Empty, Filled, Unique; Filled counts rows with a value.
File methods: file.hasLink(), file.hasTag(), file.hasProperty(), file.inFolder(), file.linksOfType(), file.backlinksOfType().
